briefing: Markets were essentially flat today (NASDAQ -0.0%, S&P +0.2%), so no strong directional signal either way. With 3 open position slots and cash above the $500 threshold, risk rules call for deploying into our best-scoring non-overbought candidates rather than sitting idle, so we added CECO, ENSG, and NOK at medium conviction.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Cash drag happens when uninvested cash sits idle in a portfolio and earns little to nothing, quietly reducing overall returns even if the rest of the portfolio performs well. That's why, even on a flat/neutral market day, it can still make sense to deploy idle cash into solid candidates rather than let it sit unproductively.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「現金拖累」指投資組合中閒置的現金未被運用，幾乎沒有回報，即使組合其他部分表現良好，整體回報仍會被悄悄拉低。因此即使在平淡的中性市況下，將閒置現金配置到優質標的上，仍比讓資金閒置更合理。

market_education.summary_en: Today was a quiet, directionless session with the NASDAQ essentially flat and the S&P 500 up only slightly, suggesting investors found no major new catalysts to push the market strongly in either direction. Without a sharp risk-on or risk-off trigger, trading stayed range-bound and institutional flows appeared muted. In this kind of environment, stock-specific momentum signals matter more than broad market direction for finding opportunities.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市窄幅波動，納指幾乎平盤，標普500指數僅微升0.2%，反映市場缺乏重大新催化劑帶動方向性走勢。在沒有明顯風險偏好或規避訊號下，資金流向保持審慎，成交亦相對淡靜。在這種環境下，個股本身的動能訊號比大盤方向更具參考價值。
